description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests for setting wireless network configurations, managing WPS, MAC filtering, SSID settings, and other wireless parameters on a device platform (specifically xb6). It includes utility files, manages user sessions, processes JSON configuration data, and interacts with device configuration parameters.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum, supporting 4 or 8 digit PINs with checksum validation.

methods.name: validFilterParam
methods.description: Validates filter parameters, ensuring printable characters and valid MAC addresses.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID, toggling its enable state and applying configurations.
